details: HashiCorp Nomad and Nomad Enterprise are vulnerable to cross-namespace authorization bypasses in several read-only API endpoints that may allow an authenticated user with read permissions in one namespace to view information about objects in other namespaces. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-102260) is fixed in Nomad Community Edition 2.1.0 and Nomad Enterprise 2.1.0, 1.11.12, and 1.10.18.
